topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Negations in the Present Perfect
title: Present Perfect: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect olumsuz biçimi:
• haven't / hasn't + V3 (past participle)
  I haven't finished my homework. She hasn't called yet.
• I/you/we/they → haven't, he/she/it → hasn't
• 'yet' olumsuz cümlelerde sona gelir: I haven't eaten yet. (Henüz yemedim.)
• 'never' ile olumlu yapı olumsuz anlam verir: I have never been to Japan. (Never ile haven't kullanılmaz.)
V3 örnekleri: do → done, see → seen, go → gone/been, eat → eaten, write → written.
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect-iň ýokluk görnüşi:
• haven't / hasn't + V3 (past participle)
  I haven't finished my homework. She hasn't called yet.
• I/you/we/they → haven't, he/she/it → hasn't
• 'yet' ýokluk sözlemlerde ahyrda gelýär: I haven't eaten yet. (Entek iýmedim.)
• 'never' bilen tassyklaýjy gurluş ýokluk manyny berýär: I have never been to Japan. (Never bilen haven't ulanylmaýar.)
V3 mysallary: do → done, see → seen, go → gone/been, eat → eaten, write → written.
explanation.ru:
Отрицательная форма Present Perfect:
• haven't / hasn't + V3 (past participle)
  I haven't finished my homework. She hasn't called yet.
• I/you/we/they → haven't, he/she/it → hasn't
• 'yet' в отрицаниях ставится в конец: I haven't eaten yet. (Я ещё не ел.)
• 'never' с утвердительной формой даёт отрицательный смысл: I have never been to Japan. (С never haven't не используется.)
Примеры V3: do → done, see → seen, go → gone/been, eat → eaten, write → written.

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Present Perfect – Sentences
title: Present Perfect: Positive Sentences

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect, geçmişte olan ama şimdiye bağlantısı olan eylemler için kullanılır.
• Yapı: have / has + V3
  I have lost my keys. (Şu an anahtarım yok.)
  She has visited Paris three times. (Hayat deneyimi)
• Kullanım: deneyimler (ever, never), yeni olaylar (just), sonuçlar (already), süre (for, since).
• Kısaltma: I've, you've, he's, she's, we've, they've.
• Zaman belirtilmez! I have seen him yesterday (✗).
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect geçmişde bolan, emma häzirki wagt bilen baglanyşygy bolan hereketler üçin ulanylýar.
• Gurluşy: have / has + V3
  I have lost my keys. (Häzir açarym ýok.)
  She has visited Paris three times. (Durmuş tejribesi)
• Ulanylyşy: tejribeler (ever, never), täze wakalar (just), netijeler (already), dowamlylyk (for, since).
• Gysgaltma: I've, you've, he's, she's, we've, they've.
• Anyk wagt aýdylmaýar! I have seen him yesterday (✗).
explanation.ru:
Present Perfect используется для действий в прошлом, связанных с настоящим.
• Схема: have / has + V3
  I have lost my keys. (Сейчас у меня нет ключей.)
  She has visited Paris three times. (Жизненный опыт)
• Употребление: опыт (ever, never), недавние события (just), результат (already), длительность (for, since).
• Сокращения: I've, you've, he's, she's, we've, they've.
• Точное время не указывается! I have seen him yesterday (✗).

examples.en: I have just finished my lunch.

examples.tk: Ol on ýyl bäri şu ýerde ýaşaýar.

examples.en: We have already seen this film.

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Questions and short answers in the Present Perfect
title: Present Perfect: Questions and Short Answers

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect'te soru:
• Have / Has + özne + V3?
  Have you finished? Has she called?
• 'ever' deneyim sorar: Have you ever been to London?
• Kısa cevaplar: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.
• 'yet' soruda sonda: Have you done it yet?
Kısa cevapta V3 tekrarlanmaz: Yes, I have. (✓) – Yes, I have finished. (uzun cevap)
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect-de sorag:
• Have / Has + eýe + V3?
  Have you finished? Has she called?
• 'ever' tejribe barada soraýar: Have you ever been to London?
• Gysga jogaplar: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.
• 'yet' soragda ahyrda: Have you done it yet?
Gysga jogapda V3 gaýtalanmaýar: Yes, I have. (✓) – Yes, I have finished. (uzyn jogap)
explanation.ru:
Вопросы в Present Perfect:
• Have / Has + подлежащее + V3?
  Have you finished? Has she called?
• 'ever' спрашивает об опыте: Have you ever been to London?
• Краткие ответы: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.
• 'yet' в вопросе — в конце: Have you done it yet?
В кратком ответе V3 не повторяется: Yes, I have. (✓) – Yes, I have finished. (полный ответ)

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Questions in the Present Perfect
title: Forming Present Perfect Questions

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect soru kurma adımları:
1. have/has özneden önce gelir: You have seen it. → Have you seen it?
2. Soru kelimesi en başa: Where have you been? What has she bought?
3. How long + Present Perfect = ne zamandır: How long have you lived here?
4. Özne sorusu: Who has taken my pen? (Who özne olduğu için has ondan sonra)
V3 değişmez: Have you eaten? Has he written?
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect soragyny düzmegiň ädimleri:
1. have/has eýeden öň gelýär: You have seen it. → Have you seen it?
2. Sorag sözi iň başda: Where have you been? What has she bought?
3. How long + Present Perfect = näçe wagtdan bäri: How long have you lived here?
4. Eýe soragy: Who has taken my pen? (Who eýe bolany üçin has ondan soň)
V3 üýtgemeýär: Have you eaten? Has he written?
explanation.ru:
Как построить вопрос в Present Perfect:
1. have/has ставится перед подлежащим: You have seen it. → Have you seen it?
2. Вопросительное слово — в самом начале: Where have you been? What has she bought?
3. How long + Present Perfect = как долго: How long have you lived here?
4. Вопрос к подлежащему: Who has taken my pen? (Who — подлежащее, has после него)
V3 не меняется: Have you eaten? Has he written?

What has she cooked for dinner?

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Rules – Present Perfect
title: Present Perfect: All the Rules

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect kuralları özeti:
1. Yapı: have/has + V3. Olumsuz: haven't/hasn't + V3. Soru: Have/Has + özne + V3?
2. Kullanım:
• Hayat deneyimi (zaman belirsiz): I have been to Rome.
• Şimdi etkisi süren geçmiş olay: She has broken her leg.
• Şimdiye kadar devam eden durum: We have lived here since 2010 / for 5 years.
• Yeni bitmiş eylem: He has just left.
3. Sinyal kelimeler: ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, since, for, recently.
4. Belli geçmiş zaman (yesterday, ago, in 2010) varsa Simple Past kullanılır.
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect düzgünleriniň jemi:
1. Gurluşy: have/has + V3. Ýokluk: haven't/hasn't + V3. Sorag: Have/Has + eýe + V3?
2. Ulanylyşy:
• Durmuş tejribesi (wagty näbelli): I have been to Rome.
• Täsiri häzir hem dowam edýän geçmiş waka: She has broken her leg.
• Häzire çenli dowam edýän ýagdaý: We have lived here since 2010 / for 5 years.
• Ýaňy tamamlanan hereket: He has just left.
3. Alamat sözler: ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, since, for, recently.
4. Belli geçmiş wagt (yesterday, ago, in 2010) bar bolsa, Simple Past ulanylýar.
explanation.ru:
Сводка правил Present Perfect:
1. Схема: have/has + V3. Отрицание: haven't/hasn't + V3. Вопрос: Have/Has + подлежащее + V3?
2. Употребление:
• Жизненный опыт (время не указано): I have been to Rome.
• Событие в прошлом с результатом сейчас: She has broken her leg.
• Ситуация, длящаяся до сих пор: We have lived here since 2010 / for 5 years.
• Только что завершённое действие: He has just left.
3. Маркеры: ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, since, for, recently.
4. Если указано время в прошлом (yesterday, ago, in 2010) — нужен Simple Past.
